name: mandala
description: Mandala tokens (BRC-162; docs/MANDALA.md): one overlay topic per token, tm_<txid>, judged by the token rules alone (mandala-topic), the discovery topic tm_mandala (every token's deploy output), the lookup service ls_mandala (mandala-lookup: a token's unspent value outputs, its authority outputs, one output by outpoint) and ls_mandala_deploys (a token id's deploy output; a token id is <txid>, <txid>_<vout> or <txid>.<vout>), on the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.9.2, required: chain/1). The token list is a read, /<app>/mandala/tokens (mandala-lookup fn tokens): {limit?, skip?} → [{tokenId, topic, sym, dec, icon?, txid, vout}], every deploy tm_mandala admitted, newest first. The manifest declares no topics: the owner registers each topic it runs with the engine, a message in the app's box register (<app>/register once installed) {fn: "register", args: {topic, program: "mandala-topic"}} (tm_<txid>, tm_<txid>_<vout> or tm_mandala), and drops it with {fn: "deregister", args: {topic}}; the registered set is the head <app>/topics. Both lookups listen to every topic the overlay serves.
